### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

No maintainer ruling. Triage direction (on the card), verbatim: 「Either draw every flow, or refuse a shape the renderer cannot draw, at publish, with a prescription. ⛔ It never draws a partial chart silently.」

### PM mechanism assumptions (measured read-only on `origin/main` `57c51aab4d`; re-measure)

- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` ~2709–2731 builds the sankey from `series[0]?.dataKey` only (one root plus one link per row); nothing handles `series.length > 1` (the only such check, ~2887, is the scatter arm).
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` ~2066 / ~2145: two dimensions with one measure pivot the second dimension into series, which the sankey arm then drops.
- The spec's `checkDashboardWidgetChartMeasureArity` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` ~890–960, `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` ~808) refuses multiple MEASURES on sankey but not multiple dimensions; `DatasetWidget.tsx` ~501 mirrors the set.
- Not verified: whether pie / donut / funnel / treemap share the same `series[0]` drop. Measure each and report; fold any that share this exact defect shape and fix into this PR only if the same fix covers them, otherwise list them in Acceptance notes.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

- Prefer "draw every flow": two dimensions on a sankey are source → target; build nodes from both dimensions and one link per (dim1, dim2) cell with the measure as the value. A refusal is the route only for shapes the renderer still cannot draw (three or more dimensions?), and then it belongs at publish with a prescription (that would touch `packages/spec/**`, which is the spec lane: if you measure that the publish-time refusal is needed, stop and report it instead of editing spec).

### Scope

- File surface: `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (sankey arm), `DatasetWidget.tsx` only if the pivot must hand the sankey both dimensions, tests beside (`AdvancedChartImpl.sankey*.test.tsx`), changeset. ⛔ `packages/spec/**`.
- Acceptance: a two-dimension sankey draws every (dim1 → dim2) flow (test with a fixture of ≥ 2 first-dimension categories, asserting link count and values); an ablation restoring `series[0]` turns it red; one-dimension sankeys unchanged.
- In-flight neighbour: PR #27340 (`os-bill`) edits `DatasetWidget.tsx` ~1883 (table cell format, other region): ordinary concurrency.
- Tier: no path-derived mandate ⇒ `TIER_DEFAULT`; effort `high` (p2, M). `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
